en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view labeled "Grünhainichen" at the top. The scene shows a gently sloping road lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century residential buildings, fences, and dense greenery. People, including children and adults, walk along the street, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the hill. Telegraphed utility poles run along the road, and in the background the rooftops of a small town and a hilly rural landscape can be seen.
